# pve_storage_prune_backups_preview (Data Source)

Backups that pruning would remove from a storage (dry run).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_prune_backups_preview" "example" {
  node    = "pve1"
  storage = "local"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier.

### Optional

- `prune_backups` (String) Use these retention options instead of those from the storage configuration.
- `type` (String) Either 'qemu' or 'lxc'. Only consider backups for guests of this type. One of: `qemu`, `lxc`.
- `vmid` (Number) Only consider backups for this guest.

### Read-Only

- `backups` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/prunebackups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backups))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<storage>.

<a id="nestedatt--backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backups`

Read-Only:

- `ctime` (Number) Creation time of the backup (seconds since the UNIX epoch).
- `mark` (String) Whether the backup would be kept or removed. Backups that are protected or don't use the standard naming scheme are not removed.
- `type` (String) One of 'qemu', 'lxc', 'openvz' or 'unknown'.
- `vmid` (Number) The VM the backup belongs to.
- `volid` (String) Backup volume ID.
